title: 우리 가족을 소개해요: 가족 호칭 10개
objective: By the end, you can use 10 family words to introduce your family in short sentences such as '저는 언니가 한 명 있어요.' You can also choose 형/오빠 and 누나/언니 based on whether the speaker is a man or a woman.
summary: Learn ten basic Korean family words and how to pick the right word for an older brother or sister based on who is speaking.

task.title: USE THE FAMILY WORDS
task.line: Read each item, then choose, write, or put in order the family words that fit.

words.exampleMeaning: My grandfather takes a walk every morning.
My father is an office worker.
My mother is a really good cook.
My older brother is a college student. (male speaker)
My older brother is three years older than me. (female speaker)
I often watch movies with my older sister. (male speaker)
I have one older sister. (female speaker)
My younger brother is a high school student.
My younger sister is taller than me.

exercises: Choose the right word for each speaker: ①민수 (a man): 우리 (형 / 오빠)는 요리사예요. ②지은 (a woman): 우리 (누나 / 언니)는 간호사예요. ③지은 (a woman): (형 / 오빠)는 지금 일본에 있어요. ④민수 (a man): 저는 (누나 / 언니)하고 같이 살아요.
Fill in the blank with a family word: ①아버지의 아버지는 제 ____예요. ②어머니의 어머니는 제 ____예요.
Read 준호's sentence and answer in English: '우리 가족은 다섯 명이에요. 아버지, 어머니, 누나, 저, 그리고 여동생이에요.' ①Is 준호 a man or a woman? How do you know? ②Who in the family is younger than 준호?
Fill in the blank to match the information: ①Mina has two younger brothers. → 미나는 ____이 두 명 있어요. ②Tom is a man. He has no older brother. → 톰은 ____이 없어요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 축구를 / 형하고 / 해요 / 주말에
Write the matching word for the other gender: ①할아버지 ↔ 할머니, 아버지 ↔ ____ ②남동생 ↔ ____
answers: ① 형 ② 언니 ③ 오빠 ④ 누나
① 할아버지 (친할아버지 also correct) ② 할머니 (외할머니 also correct). Koreans often add 친- (father's side) or 외- (mother's side) to tell the two sides of the family apart.
① A man. He calls his older sister 누나, and only men use 누나. ② His younger sister (여동생).
주말에 형하고 축구를 해요. (형하고 주말에 축구를 해요. also correct)
